1
Yeremia
1Hilkia ba Yeremia a ɔfiri asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Anatot, Benyamin asase soɔ no mu no nsɛm nie. 2#2 Ah 21.24 Ɔno na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn Yudahene Yosia a ɔyɛ Amon ba berɛ soɔ, n’ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa mu. 3#2 Ah 23.34; 24.17; 25.2, 8 Na ɛbaa Yudahene Yehoiakim a ɔyɛ Yosia ba berɛ so nso, de bɛsii Yudahene Sedekia a ɔyɛ Yosia ba afe a ɛtɔ so dubaako awieeɛ, de bɛsii Yerusalem tuo a wɔtuu wɔn kɔeɛ, bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum mu no so.
Yeremia frɛ
4Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ:
5Mennya mennwonoo wo ɔyafunu mu no, na menim wo,
# Yes 49.1; Gal 1.15 na wonnya mfirii adi mfirii awotwaa mu no, na metee wo ho;
mesii wo odiyifoɔ memaa amanaman.
6 # Eks 3.11; Yes 6.5-8 Ɛnna mekaa sɛ: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn! Nokorɛ, mennim kasa, ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ abɔfra. 7Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Nka sɛ: Meyɛ abɔfra;
na mmom baabiara a mɛsoma woɔ no, kɔ,
na asɛm biara a mɛka akyerɛ woɔ no, ka.
8Nsuro wɔn anim,
na wo deɛ, mɛdi w’akyi, na mɛgye wo,
AWURADE asɛm nie.
9 # Deut 18.18 Na AWURADE tenee ne nsa kaa m’ano. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Afei mede me nsɛm mahyɛ w’anomu.
10 # Yer 18.7-10 Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ da yi mede wo asi amanaman ne ahennie ahodoɔ so,
na woatutu na woabubu,
na woasɛe na woabutu,
na woasi na woatɛ nso.
Anisoadehunu mmienu
11Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Yeremia, ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi? Na mese: Mehu sorɔno abaa bi. 12#Yer 31.28 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Woahunu ampa; na merekanyan me ho m’asɛm ho, na mayɛ. 13Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn ne mprenu so sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi? Na mese: Ɛsɛn a ɛrehuru na mehunu, na ɛpue atifi fam. 14Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Atifi fam nso na mmusuo bɛfiri aba asase no sofoɔ nyinaa soɔ. 15Na hwɛ, mɛfrɛ atifi fam ahennie mmusua nyinaa, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔn nyinaa aba de wɔn adwa abɛsisi Yerusalem aponkɛseɛ ano, ne n’afasuo nyinaa ho ahyia, ne Yuda nkuro nyinaa ho. 16Na mabu wɔn wɔn bɔne nyinaa ho atɛn, sɛ wɔagya me, na wɔahye aduhwam ama anyame foforɔ, na wɔakoto asɔre wɔn nsa ano nnwuma. 17Enti wo deɛ, bɔ w’abɔsoɔ; na sɔre ka deɛ mɛhyɛ woɔ nyinaa kyerɛ wɔn. Mma wo ho mmpopo wɔ wɔn anim, na mamma wo ho ampopo wɔ wɔn anim. 18#Yer 15.20; Hes 3.8-9 Na me deɛ, hwɛ, ɛnnɛ mede wo mayɛ kuro a ɛyɛ den ne dadeɛ dum ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afasuo atia asase nyinaa: Yuda ahemfo, wɔn asafohene, wɔn asɔfoɔ ne asase no so nkurɔfoɔ. 19Na wɔne wo bɛdi ako, nanso wɔrentumi wo, ɛfiri sɛ meka wo ho, na mɛgye wo, AWURADE asɛm nie.

pageProps.chapterText:
Hilkia ba Yeremia a ɔfiri asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Anatot, Benyamin asase soɔ no mu no nsɛm nie. Ɔno na AWURADE asɛm baa ne nkyɛn Yudahene Yosia a ɔyɛ Amon ba berɛ soɔ, n’ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa mu. Na ɛbaa Yudahene Yehoiakim a ɔyɛ Yosia ba berɛ so nso, de bɛsii Yudahene Sedekia a ɔyɛ Yosia ba afe a ɛtɔ so dubaako awieeɛ, de bɛsii Yerusalem tuo a wɔtuu wɔn kɔeɛ, bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum mu no so.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ:
Mennya mennwonoo wo ɔyafunu mu no, na menim wo,
na wonnya mfirii adi mfirii awotwaa mu no, na metee wo ho;
mesii wo odiyifoɔ memaa amanaman.
Ɛnna mekaa sɛ: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn! Nokorɛ, mennim kasa, ɛfiri sɛ meyɛ abɔfra. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Nka sɛ: Meyɛ abɔfra;
na mmom baabiara a mɛsoma woɔ no, kɔ,
na asɛm biara a mɛka akyerɛ woɔ no, ka.
Nsuro wɔn anim,
na wo deɛ, mɛdi w’akyi, na mɛgye wo,
AWURADE asɛm nie.
Na AWURADE tenee ne nsa kaa m’ano. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ:
Afei mede me nsɛm mahyɛ w’anomu.
Hwɛ, ɛnnɛ da yi mede wo asi amanaman ne ahennie ahodoɔ so,
na woatutu na woabubu,
na woasɛe na woabutu,
na woasi na woatɛ nso.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Yeremia, ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi? Na mese: Mehu sorɔno abaa bi. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Woahunu ampa; na merekanyan me ho m’asɛm ho, na mayɛ. Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn ne mprenu so sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wohunu yi? Na mese: Ɛsɛn a ɛrehuru na mehunu, na ɛpue atifi fam. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Atifi fam nso na mmusuo bɛfiri aba asase no sofoɔ nyinaa soɔ. Na hwɛ, mɛfrɛ atifi fam ahennie mmusua nyinaa, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔn nyinaa aba de wɔn adwa abɛsisi Yerusalem aponkɛseɛ ano, ne n’afasuo nyinaa ho ahyia, ne Yuda nkuro nyinaa ho. Na mabu wɔn wɔn bɔne nyinaa ho atɛn, sɛ wɔagya me, na wɔahye aduhwam ama anyame foforɔ, na wɔakoto asɔre wɔn nsa ano nnwuma. Enti wo deɛ, bɔ w’abɔsoɔ; na sɔre ka deɛ mɛhyɛ woɔ nyinaa kyerɛ wɔn. Mma wo ho mmpopo wɔ wɔn anim, na mamma wo ho ampopo wɔ wɔn anim. Na me deɛ, hwɛ, ɛnnɛ mede wo mayɛ kuro a ɛyɛ den ne dadeɛ dum ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afasuo atia asase nyinaa: Yuda ahemfo, wɔn asafohene, wɔn asɔfoɔ ne asase no so nkurɔfoɔ. Na wɔne wo bɛdi ako, nanso wɔrentumi wo, ɛfiri sɛ meka wo ho, na mɛgye wo, AWURADE asɛm nie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
